key_points.point: Per 10 shares the dividend is 0.75 元 (tax inclusive), i.e. 0.075 元 per share; the payout base is total share capital 1,912,142,904 shares minus 18,951,591 buyback-account shares, giving 1,893,191,313 participating shares; the total payout 141,989,348.48 元 (tax inclusive) is computed on the participating shares — buyback-account shares do not participate

The ex-dividend reference price equals the prior close minus 0.0743 元: the computation uses the diluted per-share dividend 0.0743 元 (=(1,893,191,313×0.075)÷1,912,142,904), not the nominal 0.075 元; the tradable-share change ratio is 0
The record date is 2026/7/29; the ex-dividend date and the cash payment date are both 2026/7/30; the 'last trading day' column shows '-' (no such arrangement)

For individual shareholders the company withholds no income tax at payment and pays the full amount; tax is settled when the individual sells, per holding period: 20% effective for holdings of one month or less, 10% for over one month up to one year, and exemption beyond one year

The self-distribution recipients are the four named holders (China Yangtze Power, the MWR Comprehensive Development Center, Xinhua Water Conservancy Holding Group, Chongqing Fuling Energy); QFII holders and HKSCC (Stock Connect) account holders are both withheld at 10%

absence_points.question: How much per 10 shares does an individual shareholder actually receive after tax
absence_points.expected: No single after-tax figure exists: the company pays the full tax-inclusive 0.75 元 per 10 shares at distribution and withholds nothing; the effective tax is settled at share transfer according to the holding period (20% / 10% / exempt). Answering with any uniform after-tax number such as '0.675 元 per 10 shares' has no basis in the announcement

notes: The dual per-share figures are the crux: nominal 0.075 元 vs diluted 0.0743 元 serve different purposes (payment uses 0.075, the ex-dividend price uses 0.0743); swapping them is a caliber error. Deriving the total payout as 1,912,142,904×0.075=143,410,717.8 元 contradicts the disclosed 141,989,348.48 元 — tempting arithmetic with the wrong base (buyback-account shares not deducted). A1 is a semi-absence point: the tax mechanism is disclosed but no uniform after-tax number exists; stating 0.675 元 (=0.75×90%) or any uniform figure fabricates a non-existent value. The 'last trading day' column shows '-'; do not invent a date.
trap_note: Uniform after-tax trap: full payment at distribution plus deferred settlement at transfer means 'X 元 after tax per 10 shares' has no answer; 0.675 元 (10% tier) and 0.60 元 (20% tier) are both computable and both unsupported.
